name: Shade
sourceDistinctions: The Essentials-era Shade was human before a rite surrendered part of its soul to the Shadowfell. This book supplies its own rules for darkvision, reduced healing surges and hiding.
Its optional replacement utility powers begin above level 1.

supportingSources.title: Dungeon Master’s Guide (4e), NPC design steps and NPC classes
Player’s Handbook (4e), class powers and equipment

name: Vryloka
sourceDistinctions: Vryloka is a playable lineage with a blood-bond origin. Vampire has a separate class chapter in the same book.
The level 1 entry gains Lifeblood when it bloodies or kills an enemy. Its later heritage utility choices are separate.

supportingSources.title: Dungeon Master’s Guide (4e), NPC design steps and NPC classes
Player’s Handbook (4e), class powers and equipment

name: Revenant
sourceDistinctions: This is the 2011 player race. Past Life grants prerequisite eligibility only. The NPC uses human for that choice.
This build uses the printed dying and unconsciousness text and enables death saving throws for this NPC.

supportingSources.title: Dungeon Master’s Guide (4e), NPC design steps and NPC classes
Player’s Handbook (4e), class powers and equipment

name: Hamadryad
sourceDistinctions: The book presents Hamadryads as oak spirits with nymph and dryad aspects. The defensive branch of Hamadryad Aspects grants resistance instead of combat advantage.

supportingSources.title: Dungeon Master’s Guide (4e), NPC design steps and NPC classes
Player’s Handbook (4e), class powers and equipment

name: Shadar-kai
sourceDistinctions: The February 2009 Playing Shadar-Kai article gives Dexterity and Intelligence bonuses and the encounter teleport. Its origin keyword is shadow.

supportingSources.title: Dungeon Master’s Guide (4e), NPC design steps and NPC classes
